name: fld_prime_one_three_mod_eight_eq_sq_add_two_sq
informal: Every prime p ≡ 1 or 3 (mod 8) is of the form a^2 + 2b^2 — -2 is a square mod p (ZMod.exists_sq_eq_neg_two_iff / FiniteField.isSquare_neg_two_iff), so p | x^2 + 2; Thue's lemma gives 0 < a^2 + 2b^2 < 3p divisible by p, so it is p or 2p; in the latter case a is even and p = b^2 + 2(a/2)^2. Alternatively use that Z[√-2] is Euclidean.
type: ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p % 8 = 1 ∨ p % 8 = 3 → ∃ a b, p = a ^ 2 + 2 * b ^ 2
